merged_guidance.application_channel_detail: Apply from a personal account on the Russian MFA e-visa website evisa.kdmid.ru or the Russian MFA mobile application, between 86 and 4 days before the planned entry date
merged_guidance.consular_jurisdiction: Apply at the Russian consular office covering your place of permanent residence.
merged_guidance.entry_requirements: Use the same passport and show the issued e-visa notification at boarding and the border. Enter and leave only through checkpoints approved for unified e-visas. Leave within the 30-day stay and the visa’s 120-day validity; arrival and departure each count as a day. Medical insurance valid in Russia for the whole stay is required unless a published reciprocity exemption applies.
